checks.detail: Approval loaded from .launch/approval.example.json.
privatePilotApproved must be explicitly true.

PR #190 at 77757c42 remains the prior green baseline. The successor branch contains the workbook, spend, export, and first-run changes and needs a clean current-revision proof bundle before it is a release candidate.
Application TypeScript passed on the current working tree; trusted clean-commit receipt is pending.
Convex TypeScript passed on the current working tree; trusted clean-commit receipt is pending.

The current working tree passes 310/310 Vitest files and 2,118/2,118 tests. Product-memory browser proof passes 29/29, the launch-surface browser proof passes 19/19, the unchanged accounting certification suite passes 100/85, and Notion/GTM ProofLoop passes 100/80. Trusted clean-commit receipts are pending.
The current working-tree production build passes with the existing large-chunk advisory; clean-commit immutable receipt is pending.

The prior authenticated preview passed, but it does not contain the successor branch's current schema, spend admission, bounded grants, durable export receipts, launch posture query, or function-spec-bound verifier.

The no-account local sample passes locally. A fresh authenticated phone user must still prove create -> initial credits -> public durable job -> proposal/evidence -> accept/reject -> export receipt -> reload on the deployed current revision.
Deterministic PPTX bytes, SHA-256, browser delivery status, and durable receipt behavior pass locally; deployed authenticated persistence and reopen are pending.
Prior-preview reload and fail-closed rejoin passed. Current-revision receipt hydration and a successful second-user join/rejoin still need deployed proof.

No current-revision deployment has yet passed function-spec parity, exact frontend/Convex binding, strict server identity and spend posture, plus a fresh authenticated phone journey covering create, bounded grant, durable public job, proposal/evidence review, accept/reject, SHA-256 export receipt, reload, and successful second-user join/rejoin.
A complete in-product issue, deletion request, and support contact journey is not yet proven.
Existing deterministic tests cover fail-closed membership and private/public separation; the changed current revision needs clean-commit and deployed authenticated proof.
Pilot policy must explicitly restrict confidential banking data and MNPI until approved.

Local tests prove atomic begin admission/reservation, atomic idempotent finish settlement/telemetry, hard-cap-sized active commitments, bounded fresh-room grants, and no retry/fallback in launch. Isolated deployed breach proof is pending.
Local tests prove room/user projected exposure and concurrency admission, including direct-provider commitments without job double-counting. Isolated deployed proof is pending.
The canonical launch envelope now includes active commitments and atomic direct-provider admission; isolated cap-breach and provider-error billing proof are pending.

Environment-backed global, provider, maintenance, and room pause switches are wired. Launch also fails closed for unmetered nested provider tools, direct inline public runs, external embeddings, voice, and capture; deployed browser proof is pending.

The expired June finance provider batch is preserved as historical research and removed from current launch promotion. Local staleness and launch-copy tests pass; clean-commit immutable verification is pending.
The bounded job-scoped workbook session passes local contract, persistence, idempotency, and provider-schema proof; authenticated deployed proposal/accept/reject/export proof is pending.

Private/public launch intentionally disables unmetered voice, direct capture, external semantic embeddings, nested provider tools, inline public provider actions, model retries/fallbacks, and unapproved deep work. These limits require user-facing deployment verification before launch.
Support owner, rotation, and tested escalation channel are not approved.
